title: extensions/ops-digest/0.1: where a collector on the same machine reads a product's daily operations digests, and the label it sends with them (fabric-ops-digest/0.1, DEC-0153)
description: The value of the ops-digest extension key https://fabric.passioncode.ai/agent-contract/extensions/ops-digest/0.1 in a local service descriptor: 1 to 8 folders inside the product's own data folder (paths.data) that hold its daily-YYYY-MM.jsonl files (OD-6), each with the source label a collector sends with the daily lines it reads there. The digests stay as written (OD-6, OD-7). A checker reports an invalid value, a source named twice, a remote placement, and a dir or source holding a home folder or shaped like a credential as FAC-SEM-168. docs/specification/ops-digest.md#where-a-collector-reads-the-daily-digests.

dir.description: A folder inside the product's data folder (paths.data), relative to it: forward slashes, no leading / or ~, no drive, no backslash, no . or .. segment, no control character, at most 256 characters (the grammar of a package path, also used for a package's state relative to the data folder). It holds the product's daily-YYYY-MM.jsonl files (OD-6).

source.description: The label a collector sends with each daily digest read in dir, once in the list (FAC-SEM-168); app is the conventional label of a product's one folder.
